name: Lauma
description: The Moonchanter of the Frostmoon Scions. She bears the title "Maiden of the Grove" and serves as an envoy of the tranquil forest, weaving hymns to guide the lost.

skillTalents.name: Peregrination of Linnunrata
skillTalents.description:
Normal Attack
Performs up to 3 attacks that deal Dendro DMG.
Charged Attack
Lauma undergoes Spirit Envoy Metamorphosis, transforming into an envoy of the tranquil forest and consuming Stamina to charge forward for up to 10s. While in this state, Lauma's interruption resistance is increased, and she can consume additional Stamina to perform up to two consecutive jumps. When the state ends or is canceled, she unleashes a Spiritcall Prayer, dealing AoE Dendro DMG.
Plunging Attack
Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground below, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE Dendro DMG upon impact.

skillTalents.name: Runo: Dawnless Rest of Karsikko
skillTalents.description:
Silently incants an ancient hymn, summoning a Frostgrove Sanctuary with different effects depending on whether you Tap or Hold.
Tap:
Intones a Hymn of Hunting, dealing AoE Dendro DMG.
Hold:
Can be unleashed when you have at least 1 Verdant Dew. Lauma consumes all Verdant Dew and intones a Hymn of Eternal Rest, dealing one regular instance of AoE Dendro DMG and another instance of AoE Dendro DMG that is considered Lunar-Bloom DMG. Each Verdant Dew consumed will give Lauma one stack of Moon Song.
Frostgrove Sanctuary:
A magical array that follows the active character, dealing a single instance of AoE Dendro DMG to opponents within the array every 2s. This DMG is considered Elemental Skill DMG. Additionally, opponents hit by the Frostgrove Sanctuary will have their Dendro RES and Hydro RES decreased.

skillTalents.name: Runo: All Hearts Become the Beating Moon
skillTalents.description:
Lauma incants a sacred song of the far north, gaining 18 stacks of Pale Hymn. Additionally, if Lauma uses her Elemental Burst while she has Moon Song, or she gains Moon Song within 15s of using her Elemental Burst, she will consume all Moon Song stacks and gain 6 Pale Hymn stacks for every Moon Song consumed.
Pale Hymn:
Increases the DMG dealt by Bloom, Hyperbloom, Burgeon, and Lunar-Bloom reactions triggered by nearby party members based on Lauma's Elemental Mastery. When party members deal DMG with these reactions, 1 stack of Pale Hymn will be consumed.

passiveTalents.name: Light for the Frosty Night
passiveTalents.description:
For the next 20s after Lauma uses her Elemental Skill, corresponding buff effects will be granted depending on the party's Moonsign: 
- Nascent Gleam: Bloom, Hyperbloom, and Burgeon DMG dealt by party members can Score Critical Hits (Fixed CRIT Rate 15%, CRIT DMG 100%).
- Ascendant Gleam: All nearby party members' Lunar-Bloom DMG CRIT Rate +10%, CRIT DMG +20%.

passiveTalents.name: Cleansing for the Spring
passiveTalents.description:
Each point of Elemental Mastery Lauma has will give her the following bonuses:
- DMG dealt by her Elemental Skill is increased by 0.04% (Max 32%).
- The cooldown of her Charged Attack Spirit Envoy Metamorphosis is reduced by 0.02% (Max 20%).

passiveTalents.name: Nature's Chorus
passiveTalents.description: Moonsign Benediction: When a party member triggers a Bloom reaction, converts it to Lunar-Bloom. Every point of Lauma's Elemental Mastery increases Lunar-Bloom's Base DMG by 0.0175% (Max 14%). Additionally, when Lauma is in the party, the party's Moonsign level increases by 1.

passiveTalents.name: Prayers for the Forest
passiveTalents.description: Displays the location of nearby resources unique to Nod-Krai on the mini-map.

constellations.name: O Lips, Weave Me Songs and Psalms
constellations.description: After Lauma uses her Elemental Skill or Burst, she gains Threads of Life for 20s. During this time, when nearby party members trigger Lunar-Bloom reactions, nearby active characters will recover HP equal to 500% of Lauma's Elemental Mastery. This effect can trigger once every 1.9s. Additionally, the Stamina cost for Lauma's Spirit Envoy Form is reduced by 40%, and its Max Duration is extended by 5s.

constellations.name: Twine Warnings and Tales From the North
constellations.description: Lauma's Elemental Burst is enhanced: Pale Hymn effects are increased by 500% of Lauma's EM for Bloom/Hyperbloom/Burgeon and 400% for Lunar-Bloom. Under Moonsign: Ascendant Gleam, all party members' Lunar-Bloom DMG is increased by 40%.

constellations.name: Seek Not to Tread the Sly Fox's Path
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Runo: Dawnless Rest of Karsikko by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Nor Yearn for the Great Bear's Might
constellations.description: When attacks from the Frostgrove Sanctuary hit opponents, Lauma will regain 4 Elemental Energy. This effect can be triggered once every 5s.

constellations.name: If Truth May Be Subject to Witness
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Runo: All Hearts Become the Beating Moon by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: I Offer Blood and Tears to the Moonlight
constellations.description: When the Frostgrove Sanctuary attacks opponents, it deals an additional instance of AoE Dendro DMG equal to 185% of Lauma's EM (considered Lunar-Bloom DMG). This damage does not consume Pale Hymn stacks and grants Lauma 2 Pale Hymn stacks. Max 8 triggers per Frostgrove Sanctuary. Additionally, Lauma's Normal Attacks consume 1 Pale Hymn stack to deal Dendro DMG equal to 150% of her EM (considered Lunar-Bloom DMG).
